# OpenTrends

> Tech trends from 240+ sources (AI, programming, hardware, biotech, embodied AI, China tech), refreshed continuously, translated, and distilled into a ten-line daily digest with citations. Open source, self-hostable.

Agents should use the JSON API, not the HTML pages. Every endpoint is public and needs no key.

## Read this first

- [For Agents](https://opentrends.io/agents): the human-readable overview (skill, MCP, API)
- [Skill](https://opentrends.io/skills/opentrends/SKILL.md): how to use the API, with the workflow and response rules
- [Skill manifest](https://api.opentrends.io/api/skills/opentrends): current base URL, topics and endpoints (source of truth)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.opentrends.io/api-reference/spec.json)

## Endpoints

- `GET https://api.opentrends.io/api/trends/{topic}/summary?format=json&lang=zh&window=today` — the digest as data: `entries[]` with `takeaway`, `reason`, `citations[]` (`url`, `topic`); `window` is `today`, `week` or `month`; `202` means it is being generated, retry after 30s
- `GET https://api.opentrends.io/api/trends/{topic}?lang=zh&items=preview` — every source in a topic with its latest items (`title`, `url`, `publishedAt`, `hotValue`, `original.title`)
- `GET https://api.opentrends.io/api/trends/{topic}/sources/{sourceId}?lang=zh` — one source, full item list
- `GET https://api.opentrends.io/api/trends/{topic}/events?lang=zh` — clustered stories across sources
- `GET https://api.opentrends.io/api/sources` — all source ids and metadata

Topics: `featured` (the cross-topic landing digest), `ai`, `programming`, `hardware`, `biotech`, `embodied`, `cn`.
Languages: `zh`, `en`, `zh-Hant`, `ru`, `fr-FR`, `es-ES`, `de-DE`, `pt-BR`.

## Rules

- Keep item `url` links when quoting; say which source an item came from.
- Do not scrape `https://opentrends.io/...` pages; the API carries the same data.
- Do not invent items, dates or links; an empty response means nothing was found.
